trust_decision.summary: No trust decision is made before deserialization: persistence.load() executes joblib.load at pyod/utils/persistence.py:215 and only afterwards, in _handle_loaded_object, checks whether the result is a valid PyOD envelope (_is_envelope / _validate_schema_version / _check_versions at :239-241); the public compat_load() (:387-437) and the separate BaseDeepLearningDetector.load() (pyod/models/base_dl.py:346-348) unpickle with no validation at all.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names persistence.load, and this is the first joblib.load(path) call in it; a reader who stops at the summary patches or gates this line, while the schema/version validation they are thinking of actually runs after it at :239-241.

fix_sites.entry_point: pyod.utils.persistence.load -> _handle_compat_fallthrough (auto fall-through on the documented dtype ValueError)
fix_sites.module_kind: private fall-through wrapper inside the public API

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can argue the private mirror _load_with_unpickler() is reachable only through compat_load(), so guarding the two public helpers is enough, and that BaseDeepLearningDetector.load() in pyod/models is a different, legacy persistence surface.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: load(strict=False) must keep returning a raw legacy detector written by plain joblib.dump with no envelope (documented at pyod/utils/persistence.py:172-185 and :276-298, tested at pyod/test/test_persistence.py:566-574), and save()/load() round-trips plus the compat_load dtype repair must keep working; an over-broad fix that refuses every artifact without a new trusted header or that stops unpickling by default breaks these documented behaviours.

O6_input_shapes: artifact path as str, pathlib.Path, or file-like object (pyod/utils/persistence.py:405-407, :476-500)
envelope dict written by save() versus a raw legacy model written by joblib.dump (pyod/utils/persistence.py:172-185, :239, :276-298)
an aged sklearn Tree artifact that raises the dtype ValueError and triggers the compat fall-through (pyod/utils/persistence.py:182-185, :216-220)
compressed joblib artifacts versus uncompressed artifacts under mmap_mode (pyod/utils/persistence.py:458-460, :479-500)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: BaseDeepLearningDetector.load(path) unpickles any caller-supplied file with raw pickle.load and applies no envelope, schema or trust check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Deep-learning persistence is documented as a separate, explicitly deferred surface (docs/model_persistence.rst:208-217 and CHANGES.txt:226 say it stays scoped to its own future design), so a solver can argue the persistence.load advisory does not cover the DL loader.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another package: pyod/models versus pyod/utils, two files and one package boundary from the landing point; inherited by every BaseDeepLearningDetector subclass

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a trusted-load gate (or state-dict-only loader) on BaseDeepLearningDetector.save/load
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: save()/load() already exist as the only persistence API on the DL base class, and CHANGES.txt:226 explicitly reserves deep-learning state-dict persistence for its own design.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a trusted_load()/inspect_artifact() sibling that validates the envelope without unpickling the model
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: docs/model_persistence.rst:201-206 already promises a header-only inspect_artifact and a .pyod container separating metadata from the payload; a maintainer would add it next to compat_load.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a `pyod inspect <artifact>` subcommand that opens a saved artifact
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the CLI already dispatches install/info/mcp subcommands and docs/model_persistence.rst:201-206 names `pyod inspect <path>` as planned.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an MCP tool that loads a saved detector from a caller-supplied path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the server already accepts local file paths in _load_data (with allow_pickle=False for numpy), so an artifact-loading tool is a natural sibling needing the same trust gate.

O9_family: CWE-502 deserialization of untrusted data (insecure artifact load, validation after unpickle), with a CWE-20 input-validation component

O10_build.toolchain: setuptools>=77 / pyproject.toml build backend; requirements.txt pins joblib>=1.5, numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, matplotlib, numba; tests run with pytest or unittest
O10_build.project_tests: pyod/test/test_persistence.py (31 unittest tests covering save/load/compat_load, including a committed binary fixture pyod/test/fixtures/iforest_sklearn_1_2_x.joblib); .github/workflows/testing-cron.yml has a persistence-nightly job that runs only this file.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a trust/schema check at the top of load() or inside _handle_loaded_object, after joblib.load has already unpickled, and leave compat_load/_load_with_unpickler and BaseDeepLearningDetector.load() untouched.
